name: aomi-transact
description: Build natural-language crypto agents, web3 assistants, and trading bots that read and write EVM chain state. Aomi turns prompts ("swap 1 ETH for USDC", "open a 3x GMX long", "bet $100 on Polymarket") into wallet-signed transactions on Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, Linea — non-custodial, fork-simulated. Use when the user wants a crypto/DeFi agent, AI trading/wallet assistant, or on-chain execution against Uniswap, Aave, Lido, GMX, Hyperliquid, Polymarket, Binance, OKX, or 40+ other protocols. Trigger with prompts about swaps, lending, bridging, staking, perps, prediction markets, or any DeFi/CEX action needing a wallet signature. Account-abstraction aware with EIP-7702/4337 in the backend lane; local CLI signing is EOA. MUST NOT fabricate or echo credentials; values reach the CLI only when the user explicitly supplied them.
